sections.text:
This procedure details 
 the testing procedures 
 P1, which recommended to be carried out every six months as indicated by M6 
 in the title block.

The purpose of the relay is 
 basically to prevent damage on the turbine, if the driving torque less than 
 the total losses in the generator and the prime mover, the generator start to 
 work as a synchronous compensator, taking the necessary active power from the 
 network

The reverse power relay is provided with one step, the relay shall be set at 
 10% of the generator rated power and shall give a trip after a time delay of 
 10 sec. The relay contains one directional current unit and one time delay 
 unit.

The first draft initiated by eng. Baha Salah Farag, tested by eng. Badry Atea 
 Rofaiel, 
 accepted by eng. Abdel Azem Gomaa Hagrasy, certified by eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab: UEEPC quality control head sector & MPIS 
 coordinator, and approved by eng. Hussein Ahmed Mahdy: head sector of Assiut 
 Steam PS.

A work 
 permit must be issued, the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety ID category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear your Safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, shoes, safety belt.... etc

Wear your Safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, shoes, safety belt.... etc
The line is out of service
Isolate the relay from PT`s & CT`s
Test transformer to give the test voltage (7v).

Selector switch to get the test voltage from the test transformer to the relay 
 and isolate the voltage coming from the main unit transformer.

Turn the supply 
 voltage switch from the off position to the auxiliary voltage position.

Insert the 
 special test key into the test selector switch (b5).

Change the 
 position of the test selector switch by the test key on the test panel to the 
 test delay action position.

Press on the test 
 key button until the signal appears.

Release the 
 button of the test key and return the selector back to its first position 
 (action).

Return the supply 
 voltage selector switch back to its off position.

Reset the reverse 
 power relay to its normal position.

Record the values 
 (results) on the test sheet.

sections.text:
Our 
 relay has a special working mechanism with two coils one coil for the current 
 sample and the other for the voltage, during the generator working the relay 
 is supplied from the voltage and current transformer of the generator along 
 two auxiliary contacts of a selector switch (b5) and during the test (the unit 
 is out of service) the relay is supplied from test transformer, which give 
 (7v) to the terminals 1,2 of the relay along the voltage selector switch which 
 disconnect the other auxiliary contacts which getting the voltage from the 
 generator and connect them to the testing transformer to give (100 v) to the 
 terminals 3,4 of the relay as shown in the figure and the 110 volt (d.c) is 
 connected through the terminals 5,6.As the injection value from the testing 
 transformer reached to the setting the relay operate with time delay (10 
 sec).

MRDS 
Maintenance Record Data Sheet 
MRDS

The operating values of the relay are suitably tested when 
the unit is on the routine maintenance (approximately every six months).
